title: Pre-Registered Predictions for the Entropy Flow Cosmology (EFC) Model
abstract: This preregistration freezes and publicly archives the Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) model’s benchmark parameters, EFT mapping, and a sealed set of testable observational predictions prior to Euclid DR1, Rubin DP2, and SO×Euclid releases. It specifies percent-level shifts of key observables relative to ΛCDM on Euclid quasi-linear scales, the characteristic µ<1, Σ>1, η>1 signature, and explicit kill criteria, all anchored by DOIs and a SHA-256 hash.
